games.description: An unfinished asymmetric train escape with APL Fisher. Sark and APL solve the storage, passenger-car, wiring and kitchen puzzles, then preview the next carriage before stopping with two cars still to complete.
games.title: How 2 Escape

games.description: Sark takes a brief look at the newly released climbing game while waiting for APL. Loud music, sparse settings and poor movement end the test after a few initial platforming attempts.
games.title: ONLY UP : Rising

games.description: Sark follows a zombie-outbreak escape through the city and a sprawling laboratory. He retrieves the T-virus, reaches the helicopter and watches the game’s betrayal ending.
games.title: Resident Fear: Redistribution

games.description: Sark returns to the asylum for another sequence of calendar pages, doctor visits and shifting rooms. A wheelchair ride and increasingly strange patients break up the routine before the conclusion.
